title: Recognize activated DEHU email contact statuses
notes: The public DEHU contact frontend shows status 1 as verified and status 2 as activated. The read-only CLI currently marks only status 1 as confirmed.
done_when: The reader reports verified and activated addresses as confirmed and preserves unverified, deactivated and unlinked statuses as false.
result: Recognize activated DEHU email contact statuses
evidence: The current DEHU frontend maps status 1 to verified and 2 to activated, and both count as active addresses. Focused Vitest validation passed 27 tests covering confirmation statuses, the contact reader, the CLI, and the email removal path.
